text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Look closely, world! Glory— lies only 
ahead of those who pursue it!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is what possibility looks like! 
Hyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

Seeking the Pearl showed the world the 
race of her life. Going head-to-head 
against Taiki Shuttle, who had just won 
the Prix Jacques le Marois.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Back-to-back wins! It's consecutive 
victories! Seeking the Pearl has defeated 
Taiki Shuttle in the Mile Championship as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Her strength isn't limited to just 1200m! 
Here stands another world-class Mile 
Monarch!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... Good job, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... Pearl-san...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... For inspiring me. For being my 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because it was you I faced 
that I was able to show this brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san... Today, I had a thought. If 
it's really true...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I thought Pearl-san might be the first one 
to become a global G1 winner. Because 
she's just that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, who knows? Though for me, what 
brings me the most joy is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that, Taiki. You, who 
conquered the world.
The two praise one another. And then—
choice_data_list: Come on, Pearl, share your message.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A message...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's true. This center stage that 
we fought so hard to win...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everybody all over the world is watching. 
All thanks to Taiki conquering the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ah... Is the lapel mic working? All 
good to go?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho, Seeking the Pearl is here! I hope 
you were watching my glorious victory.
(UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As you know, Taiki Shuttle is an amazing 
horse girl. Even so, the reason I was able 
to win...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't because I was strong. It was 
because I was able to believe 
wholeheartedly in my own potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Any dream can come true." People say that 
all the time. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so. There are dreams that 
simply don't come true. —BUT!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if a dream can come true, it won't if 
you don't believe in it! Look deep inside 
yourself, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What you can do, what is possible for you, 
the answer to that definitely lies within 
each and every one of you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to show it to the whole world. 
And I intended to save them, but..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, there were times when 
she saved me too.

"Times when she saved me too... Those were 
words I had never heard before."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to deliver hope and possibility to 
the whole world no matter what. Whenever I 
thought of that, I could rise from any 
hardship.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"This goal was my very hope! Truly, it 
shone with the brilliant radiance of a 
pearl!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hope is... so bootiful, isn't it? Very 
much so.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Listen, gallerias of the world, okay? 
Every single one of you possesses a power 
that you might not even realize yourself.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Take one step fly from where you are right 
now! Just like I showed you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, everyone holds potential within them.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I was born to share this, and I achieved 
this victory! Thanks, everyone!"
(UOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Asian Young Man
text_block_list.text: Possibility...

text_block_list.name: German Girl
text_block_list.text: Sie hat es geschafft … Potential …

text_block_list.name: Old Lady Guide
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has potential... Wait, could you 
be that young lady who came sightseeing 
back then...?

text_block_list.name: Old Lady Guide
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... I used to think we amounted 
to nothing after all, but...

text_block_list.name: Old Lady Guide
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought it'd take ten years 
to get a pat on the back like that?

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who won... against the one 
and only Ms. Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ms. Seeking the Pearl...? Just like 
me..."

How far across the world did that message 
from a small country on the eastern edge 
reach? Still—

Seeking the Pearl poured every ounce of 
her feelings into her running, conveying 
them with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Pearl-san, please! I have a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I lost today, BUT I can still run more! 
That is why...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's race again next year!! Over and over 
and over again!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Taiki... Hehe, that answer is—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —No♪ No, Taiki!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, why, why is that desu?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious, Trainer? After all, we 
still have unfinished business.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Because you beat me to it, there are still 
things left for me to do.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, conquering European G1s! So our 
showdown will have to wait for a while♪”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'm going to meet the Pearl 
Family all across the globe! Good 
luuuuck!!

I hurriedly ran after her. Indeed, Seeking 
the Pearl's quest was far from over.

Now, let us achieve that fateful European 
GⅠ victory. With a run that transcends 
fate itself.
